release_use_policy: CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use with attribution; retain this registry and the provider metadata with every derived corpus. These few performer/session clusters are development hard-negative expansion only and are not the disjoint 150-partition release set.

sources.title: GuitarSet
sources.ground_truth_basis: The official dataset page documents 360 expressly recorded excerpts and identifies audio_mono-mic as the monophonic reference-microphone WAV recording.
sources.partition_basis: player identity parsed from the official excerpt naming convention
sources.limitations: Six guitarists playing related lead sheets; useful sparse/acoustic hard negatives but not representative of full-mix diversity.

sources.title: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset
sources.ground_truth_basis: The provider describes 10.1 hours of monophonic recorded audio from 20 professional singers; the archive contains the released WAV corpus.
sources.limitations: A-cappella singing only; many files from each singer are correlated and must remain in one partition.

sources.title: Groove MIDI Dataset
sources.ground_truth_basis: Google documents aligned high-quality synthesized audio captured from a Roland TD-11 for 1,150 human drum performances and distributes paired WAV files.
sources.partition_basis: official drummer and recording-session fields in info.csv
sources.limitations: Electronic-drum-module output rather than acoustic full mixes; valuable percussive and sparse controls but not release evidence on its own.

sources.title: ChoraleBricks: A Modular Multitrack Dataset for Wind Music Research
sources.ground_truth_basis: The provider describes two hours and ten minutes of isolated wind-instrument recordings plus reproducible ensemble combinations.
sources.partition_basis: recorded performer/instrument session; derived mixes inherit every contributing partition
sources.limitations: Only ten chorales, with strong dependence between modular combinations; use original isolated recordings as masters and never count permutations as independent.
